device.description: 24-bit 2-channel bridge-sensor delta-sigma ADC with PGA (1/2/64/128), 10/80 SPS, pin-controlled, 2-wire serial interface (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK), temperature sensor
device.note: ads1232.pdf (SBAS350H) p.3-4 pin configuration and functions (Table 4-1), p.6 recommended operating conditions (DVDD 2.7-5.3 V), p.7 electrical characteristics (data rate 9.75-10.3 / 78-82.4 SPS, VIH/VIL), p.15-16 input channel selection (Tables 7-1, 7-2), p.21 settling, p.22 data rate (Table 7-6), data format (Table 7-7), DRDY/DOUT, SCLK, p.23 data retrieval (Figure 7-9, Table 7-8: t4 = 50 ns), p.24-25 offset calibration, standby, p.26 power-down

registers.name: MUX
registers.note: internal: A0 pin level (Table 7-1, p.15); 0 = AINP1/AINN1, 1 = AINP2/AINN2

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the SPEED / GAIN pin levels (pins.levels); no serial registers

pages: p.3-4 (pins), p.6 (ROC), p.7 (EC), p.15-16 (mux), p.21 (settling), p.22 (data rate, format, DRDY/DOUT), p.23 (retrieval timing), p.24-26 (calibration, standby, power-down)
notModeled: analog inputs, PGA gain (GAIN0/GAIN1 levels are stored only), reference
conversion time is 1 / the minimum internal-oscillator data rate (9.75 / 78 SPS, p.7); an external clock or crystal on CLKIN/XTAL1 (fCLK / 491,520 or / 61,440) is not modeled
settling after an A0/A1 or TEMP change: DRDY/DOUT held high for t1 = 51 / 401 ms (p.21); the model just continues converting
DRDY/DOUT stays at the last data bit until the next update unless a 25th SCLK forces it high (Figure 7-10); modeled as idle 1 after the 24 bits
offset calibration started by 26 SCLKs (t8 = 101.3 / 801 ms) and standby mode (SCLK held high after DRDY/DOUT falls, t10, wake-up t11) and standby with calibration
data-update window t6 (39 us, no readback) and data overwritten if not read within t7
PDWN also resets the ADC and must be toggled at power-up (modeled as power-down only; there are no serial registers)
temperature sensor (TEMP pin level is stored only)
variants: ADS1232 (24-pin, 2 channels, TEMP pin) and ADS1234 (28-pin, 4 channels, A1 pin) share ads1232.pdf: own spec files
